name: Override: carry a stack to a Neutral Goal
description: Turns to aim 0.53 in right of the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5), because the robot's middle slides about 1 in as it turns in place, and drives the bite until the stack is under the claw's middle. The jaws take a stack only within about 0.1 in of the middle side to side, and hold it wherever it is front to back. The claw closes on the Cup below its rim and the Pin above its flange, and the robot sets the stack on the Pin in the neutral left Goal. The lift rises once the robot has driven 3 in toward the Goal, not during the turn, and carries the stack at Over a stack on a Neutral Goal, 22.66 in: carried at Over a Neutral Goal, 0.25 in over the Pin's tip, the Pin knocks the stack out of the jaws as the bite takes the Goal. The lift goes down 0.3 s after the robot starts backing away. The left Toggle is still yellow, so the stack scores for neither alliance.

steps.note: aim 0.53 in right of the stack; the robot's middle slides as it turns
the bite until the stack is under the claw's middle
close on the Cup and the Pin
toward the Goal, the lift still down
the bite onto the Goal, the stack well over its Pin; the Goal stops it 1.1 s in
set the Cup's rim on the Goal's Pin
back away, then lower the lift
